items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: He'd send me in his place. Yeah, Roddy was with him for a long time. Yeah, Roddy was beginning to get sick. I would go in his place.

ctx.x: Did they have two altos sometimes you played with them? Yeah, sometimes they had two altos in the tenor. Oh, and the dance band. But Paul Bonds didn't play in the street much, huh? Yes, he played alto. He played alto sometimes. Oh, I see. I got the street. When did you play with the Eureka recently or years ago? Oh, years ago.

Oh, I met about Eureka about last, seven years ago. I played the Eureka. But I wasn't considered a member of the band at that time. I just was fiddling, pain-ditting. Somebody couldn't make it such as Harold. You know, couldn't make it. He'd send me in his place. Yeah, Roddy was with him for a long time. Yeah, Roddy was beginning to get sick. I would go in his place.
